name: Barbarian audit: Cheers! redirects damage and reduces damage taken natively (#3573)
contract: Cheers! (805810) is not a passive -- it is cast on a friendly target ('Designate an ally as your drinking partner'). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_SPLIT_DAMAGE_PCT (81, EffectBasePoints 10 DieSides 0 -> amount 10, MiscValue 127 = all schools), consumed generically in Unit::CalcAbsorbResist's caller (Unit.cpp ~2685-2733): when the ally (aura holder) takes damage, CalculatePct(damage, GetAmount()) is absorbed off the ally and dealt to (*itr)->GetCaster() -- the Barbarian who cast Cheers! -- exactly the tooltip's 'causing $s1% of all damage they take to be redirected to you'; needs no script. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87, EffectBasePoints -5 DieSides 0 -> amount -5, MiscValue 127), the same generic HandleNoImmediateEffect aura already proven native for #2549, read here through the melee_damage_taken metric -- the tooltip's 'reducing all damage they take by $s2%'. Effect 2 is SPELL_EFFECT_FORCE_CAST (140, EffectTriggerSpell 801652), handled generically by Spell::EffectForceCast; 801652 is itself SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY (3, EffectBasePoints -1 DieSides 1 -> amount 0) with no SpellScript registered under src/server/scripts (grepped for 801652 and 805810, no matches), so it currently has no observable effect and is not asserted -- it appears to be inert DBC plumbing rather than part of the 'designate an ally'/'only 1 at a time' bookkeeping, which this scenario does not otherwise need since only one ally is designated. This scenario proves the damage-redirect and damage-reduction mechanics (what #3573 reports as unimplemented) already work through stock engine code. Removal is exercised with set_aura(stacks:0) on the ally, not unlearn: Cheers! is cast by b onto ally, so ally never has 805810 in its own spellbook (only b does) -- unlike #2549's Unrelenting, which is learned and self-applied by the same actor it is asserted on, so unlearning it there correctly strips the aura. Calling unlearn on ally for a spell only b ever learned is a spellbook no-op on the wrong actor and can never remove ally's active aura; the harness's own set_aura action (README: 'zero removes it') is the documented way to clear a fixture aura directly and observe HandleNoImmediateEffect's damage-taken-pct correctly recalculate to baseline once the aura is gone.

steps.label: Baseline damage the ally takes from b
The ally now takes 5% less damage from b
Removing Cheers! restores the ally's baseline damage taken
